hooks.description: Whenever a file under backend/ is saved, run the unit checks for the deterministic matching engine (match.py) so a broken rule is caught immediately.
hooks.name: matching-engine-unit-checks

hooks.description: Before any commit, verify that every exception in the dossier carries an evidence reference (order line, invoice line, and/or portal value). Block the commit if any exception lacks evidence.
hooks.name: dossier-evidence-verification

note: Self-describing hook configuration for Ghost Auditor. Kiro's exact hook schema may differ; adapt the trigger/action fields to the installed Kiro version before relying on these automations.
